# Onira

> Onira is a free Android app that writes a personal self-hypnosis session with an AI model, then narrates it aloud. When the phone can run the model (about 6 GB of RAM or more), everything is written on the phone, offline, and nothing the user types leaves the device; otherwise, or if the user prefers, Onira Cloud writes it on Onira's own server, only after the user agrees, without storing it. Which phones qualify: https://onirahypno.com/guides/which-phones-can-run-onira-offline/

Onira is a relaxation and self-hypnosis tool, not therapy, medical or psychiatric advice, and not a substitute for professional care or emergency services.

Free, no account, no subscription; a one-time purchase removes ads. Sessions are available in English, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and German. Not every theme or guide is published in every language: each page exists where people search for it.

## App

- [Onira on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oytaub.mindease): install page; Android, free with ads
- [Privacy policy](https://onirahypno.com/privacy/): Personalized sessions are written on the phone or, only after the user agrees, with Onira Cloud (encrypted, not stored); new installs are asked the first time they start one, ready-made sessions send nothing. Ads (Google AdMob, unless removed), Play Billing purchases and anonymous 1-5 star session ratings (Firebase) are the only data that leaves the phone. No account exists, so uninstalling deletes everything.
- [Home page](https://onirahypno.com/): what the app does and how a session is built
- [Dossier de presse (FR)](https://onirahypno.com/fr/presse/): press kit in French, with downloadable visuals

## Session themes (English)

- [Anxiety](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/anxiety/): Guided self-hypnosis for anxiety, written on your phone around what you are actually anxious about, and narrated aloud. Private, free, no subscription.
- [Sleep](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/sleep/): Self-hypnotherapy for sleep, written on your phone around what is keeping you awake and narrated aloud. It can run fully offline, on the device.
- [Confidence](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/confidence/): Guided self-hypnosis for confidence, written on your phone around the situation you actually face, and narrated aloud. Private and free.
- [Stress](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/stress/): Guided self-hypnosis for stress, written on your phone around the pressure you are actually under, and narrated aloud. Private, can run offline.
- [Quitting smoking](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/quit-smoking/): Guided self-hypnosis to support quitting smoking, written on your phone around your own triggers and reasons, and narrated aloud. Private and free.
- [Focus](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/focus/): Guided self-hypnosis for focus, written on your phone around the work you are about to do, and narrated aloud. It can run fully offline.
- [Weight](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/weight-loss/): Self-hypnotherapy for weight loss and eating habits, written on your phone around your own patterns and narrated aloud. Private, free, no subscription.
- [Fear](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/fear-and-phobias/): Guided self-hypnosis for fear of flying, driving or heights, written on your phone around the situation you actually face. Private, free, can run offline.
- [Memory](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/memory-and-learning/): Guided self-hypnosis for studying, recall and language learning, written on your phone around what you are learning. Free, private, can run offline.
- [Motivation](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/motivation-and-energy/): Guided self-hypnosis for procrastination, low energy and getting started, written on your phone around the task you are avoiding. Free and private.
- [Nervous habits](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/nervous-habits/): Guided self-hypnosis for nail biting, teeth grinding and jaw clenching, written on your phone around your own trigger. Private, free, can run offline.
- [Pain](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/pain/): Guided self-hypnosis alongside your treatment: less bracing, less dread of the next flare, easier nights. A comfort tool, not a cure. Can run offline.
- [IBS](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/ibs/): Guided self-hypnosis for the stress side of IBS: calmer gut, less anticipation, easier days. A relaxation tool alongside your care, not a treatment.
- [Emotional recovery](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/emotional-recovery/): Guided self-hypnosis for the aftermath of a hard time: calmer nights, less rumination, steadier days. A relaxation tool, not trauma therapy.
- [Anger](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/anger/): Guided self-hypnosis to ease anger and short tempers: calm the body first, then rehearse a slower reaction to your own triggers. Private, free, can run offline.
- [Burnout](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/burnout/): Guided self-hypnosis for the tired, wired state of burnout: real rest, switching work off, and sleep. A relaxation aid, not a treatment. Can run offline.
- [Waking at night](https://onirahypno.com/hypnosis/waking-up-at-night/): A guided session for waking in the night and not getting back to sleep: lower the alertness, let go of the clock, drift off again. Private, can run offline.

## Guides (English)

- [Falling asleep](https://onirahypno.com/guides/how-to-fall-asleep-with-self-hypnosis/): A step-by-step self-hypnosis method for falling asleep when your mind will not stop, and what to do when it does not work the first time.
- [Hypnosis vs meditation](https://onirahypno.com/guides/hypnosis-vs-meditation/): What actually separates guided hypnosis from meditation, what each one is good at, and how to pick between them for sleep, anxiety or a habit.
- [Does it work?](https://onirahypno.com/guides/does-self-hypnosis-work/): An honest look at what self-hypnosis is good for, what the evidence supports, who it does not work for, and how to tell it is doing something.
- [Street hypnosis](https://onirahypno.com/guides/how-street-hypnosis-works/): What is really happening in street hypnosis: the stiff arm, the handshake, why it works on some people and not others, and whether it is legal.
- [Is it safe?](https://onirahypno.com/guides/is-self-hypnosis-safe/): The honest risks of self-hypnosis, who should skip it, and the situations where it needs a doctor first — pregnancy, epilepsy, children and more.
- [Learning it](https://onirahypno.com/guides/how-to-learn-self-hypnosis/): A realistic way to learn self-hypnosis on your own: what to practise first, how long it takes, what going under feels like, and when to stop.
- [Running an LLM on a phone](https://onirahypno.com/guides/running-an-llm-on-a-phone/): How Onira runs a fine-tuned Gemma 4 E2B with llama.cpp on Android: memory, mmap, threads, weight repacking and token bans, with numbers from real phones.
- [Compatible phones](https://onirahypno.com/guides/which-phones-can-run-onira-offline/): Onira writes sessions on the phone, offline, when it has about 6 GB of RAM. How to check yours, and what Onira Cloud does on other phones.
- [AI hypnosis apps compared](https://onirahypno.com/guides/best-ai-hypnosis-apps/): Onira, Hypnothera, InTheMoment and Hypnova compared: free tier, account, offline use, Android, languages and prices, checked on their own sites.
- [Onira vs Hypnothera](https://onirahypno.com/guides/onira-vs-hypnothera/): Onira vs Hypnothera: free tier, account, offline use, voices, languages and prices compared from Hypnothera's own site, to choose by what matters to you.
- [Onira vs InTheMoment](https://onirahypno.com/guides/onira-vs-inthemoment/): Onira vs InTheMoment: free sessions, account, offline use, languages and prices compared from InTheMoment's own site, to choose the app that suits you.
- [Onira vs Hypnova](https://onirahypno.com/guides/onira-vs-hypnova/): Onira vs Hypnova: library, credits, account, offline use and prices compared from Hypnova's own site, to choose by the way you like to listen.

- [Medo](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/medos-e-fobias/): Auto-hipnose guiada para medo de voar, dirigir ou altura, escrita no seu telefone ao redor da situação que você realmente enfrenta. Grátis, até offline.
- [Memória](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/memoria-e-aprendizado/): Auto-hipnose guiada para estudar, memorizar e aprender idiomas, escrita no seu celular a partir do que você está estudando. Grátis, até offline.
- [Motivação](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/motivacao-e-energia/): Auto-hipnose guiada para procrastinação, baixa energia e para começar, escrita no seu celular em torno da tarefa que você está evitando. Gratuita e privada.
- [Hábitos nervosos](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/habitos-nervosos/): Auto-hipnose guiada para roer unhas, ranger os dentes ou travar a mandíbula, escrita no seu celular em torno do seu gatilho. Grátis, até offline.
- [Dor](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/dor/): Auto-hipnose como complemento ao seu tratamento: menos tensão, menos medo da próxima crise, noites mais tranquilas. Um conforto, não uma cura.
- [SII](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/sindrome-do-intestino-irritavel/): Auto-hipnose guiada para o lado estressante da SII: intestino mais calmo, menos antecipação, dias mais leves. Um apoio ao seu tratamento, não um tratamento.
- [Recuperação emocional](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/recuperacao-emocional/): Auto-hipnose guiada depois de um período difícil: noites mais tranquilas, menos ruminação, dias mais estáveis. Relaxamento, não terapia para trauma.
- [Raiva](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/controlar-a-raiva/): Auto-hipnose guiada para a raiva e o pavio curto: acalme o corpo primeiro e treine uma reação mais lenta aos seus gatilhos. Grátis, até offline.
- [Esgotamento](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/burnout/): Auto-hipnose guiada para o burnout: descanso de verdade, desligar do trabalho e dormir melhor. Um apoio ao relaxamento, não um tratamento.
- [Acordar à noite](https://onirahypno.com/pt/hipnose/acordar-de-madrugada/): Uma sessão guiada para quando você acorda de madrugada e não volta a dormir: baixe o alerta, esqueça o relógio e adormeça de novo.

## Guides (Português)

- [Adormecer](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/como-dormir-com-auto-hipnose/): Um método de auto-hipnose passo a passo para adormecer quando sua mente não para, e o que fazer se não funcionar na primeira tentativa.
- [Hipnose vs meditação](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/hipnose-ou-meditacao/): O que separa a hipnose guiada da meditação, para que cada uma serve melhor e como escolher para dormir, ansiedade ou mudar um hábito.
- [Funciona mesmo?](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/auto-hipnose-funciona/): Uma análise honesta: para que a auto-hipnose serve, o que as pesquisas mostram, para quem não funciona e como saber se está fazendo efeito.
- [Hipnose de rua](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/como-funciona-a-hipnose-de-rua/): O que realmente acontece na hipnose de rua: o braço rígido, o aperto de mão congelado, por que funciona em algumas pessoas e não em outras, e se é legal.
- [É seguro?](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/auto-hipnose-e-segura/): Os riscos reais da auto-hipnose, quem deve evitá-la e quando é necessário consultar um médico antes — gravidez, epilepsia, crianças e mais.
- [Aprendendo](https://onirahypno.com/pt/guias/como-aprender-auto-hipnose/): Um método realista para aprender auto-hipnose sozinho: o que praticar primeiro, quanto tempo leva, como é o transe e quando parar.

## Session themes (Deutsch)

- [Angst](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/angst/): Geführte Selbsthypnose bei Angst, erstellt auf deinem Handy genau zu dem, worüber du dir tatsächlich Sorgen machst, und vorgelesen. Privat, kostenlos, kein Abo.
- [Schlafen](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/schlafen/): Selbsthypnose für besseren Schlaf, individuell auf dein Handy zugeschnitten und basierend auf dem, was dich wachhält. Kann komplett offline laufen.
- [Selbstvertrauen](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/selbstbewusstsein/): Geführte Selbsthypnose für mehr Selbstvertrauen, zugeschnitten auf deine konkrete Situation, direkt auf dem Handy erstellt und vorgelesen. Privat und kostenlos.
- [Stress](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/stress/): Geführte Selbsthypnose gegen Stress, maßgeschneidert für deinen aktuellen Druck, direkt auf dem Handy. Privat, auch offline.
- [Rauchen aufhören](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/rauchen-aufhoeren/): Geführte Selbsthypnose zum Rauchstopp, auf deinem Handy aus deinen eigenen Auslösern und Gründen geschrieben und vorgelesen. Privat und kostenlos.
- [Fokus](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/konzentration/): Geführte Selbsthypnose für mehr Fokus, auf deinem Handy rund um die anstehende Arbeit geschrieben und vorgelesen. Kann offline laufen.
- [Gewicht](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/abnehmen/): Selbsthypnose zum Abnehmen und für bessere Essgewohnheiten, auf deinem Handy aus deinen eigenen Mustern geschrieben. Kostenlos, ohne Abo.
- [Angst](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/aengste-und-phobien/): Geführte Selbsthypnose bei Flugangst, Angst vorm Autofahren oder Höhenangst, geschrieben für die Situation, die dir bevorsteht. Kostenlos, auch offline.
- [Gedächtnis](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/lernen-und-gedaechtnis/): Geführte Selbsthypnose zum Lernen, Erinnern und Sprachenlernen, auf deinem Handy rund um deinen Lernstoff geschrieben. Kostenlos, auch offline.
- [Motivation](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/motivation-und-energie/): Geführte Selbsthypnose gegen Aufschieben und Antriebslosigkeit, geschrieben für die Aufgabe, die du gerade vor dir herschiebst. Kostenlos.
- [Nervöse Gewohnheiten](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/nervoese-angewohnheiten/): Geführte Selbsthypnose bei Nägelkauen, Zähneknirschen und verspanntem Kiefer, auf deinem Handy rund um deinen Auslöser geschrieben. Auch offline.
- [Schmerzen](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/schmerzen/): Geführte Selbsthypnose als Ergänzung zur Behandlung: weniger Anspannung, weniger Angst vor dem nächsten Schub, ruhigere Nächte. Kein Heilmittel.
- [Reizdarm](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/reizdarm/): Geführte Selbsthypnose für die Stressseite des Reizdarms: ein ruhigerer Bauch, weniger Erwartungsangst, leichtere Tage. Ergänzung, kein Ersatz.
- [Emotionale Erholung](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/emotionale-heilung/): Geführte Selbsthypnose nach einer schweren Zeit: ruhigere Nächte, weniger Grübeln, stabilere Tage. Ein Entspannungstool, keine Traumatherapie.
- [Wut](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/wut-kontrollieren/): Geführte Selbsthypnose bei Wut und kurzer Zündschnur: erst den Körper beruhigen, dann eine langsamere Reaktion auf deine Auslöser üben. Auch offline.
- [Burnout](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/burnout/): Geführte Selbsthypnose bei Burnout, wenn du müde und zugleich aufgedreht bist: echte Erholung, Abschalten, besserer Schlaf. Keine Behandlung.
- [Nachts aufwachen](https://onirahypno.com/de/hypnose/naechtliches-aufwachen/): Eine geführte Sitzung, wenn du nachts aufwachst und nicht mehr einschläfst: Wachheit senken, die Uhr vergessen, wieder einschlafen.

## Guides (Deutsch)

- [Einschlafen](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/mit-selbsthypnose-einschlafen/): Eine schrittweise Selbsthypnose-Methode zum Einschlafen, wenn der Kopf nicht still wird, und was du tun kannst, wenn es beim ersten Mal nicht klappt.
- [Hypnose vs. Meditation](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/hypnose-oder-meditation/): Was Hypnose und Meditation wirklich unterscheidet, wofür beide gut sind und wie du für Schlaf, Angst oder eine Gewohnheit die richtige wählst.
- [Funktioniert es?](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/funktioniert-selbsthypnose/): Ein ehrlicher Blick darauf, wofür Selbsthypnose gut ist, was die Forschung unterstützt, für wen sie nicht funktioniert und wie du erkennst, dass sie wirkt.
- [Straßenhypnose](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/wie-funktioniert-strassenhypnose/): Was bei der Straßenhypnose wirklich passiert: der steife Arm, der eingefrorene Händedruck, warum es nur bei manchen klappt, und ob es legal ist.
- [Ist das sicher?](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/ist-selbsthypnose-gefaehrlich/): Die ehrlichen Risiken der Selbsthypnose, wer darauf verzichten sollte und wann du erst ärztlichen Rat brauchst: Schwangerschaft, Epilepsie, Kinder.
- [Lernen](https://onirahypno.com/de/ratgeber/selbsthypnose-lernen/): Ein realistischer Weg, Selbsthypnose allein zu lernen: was du zuerst übst, wie lange es dauert, wie sich Trance anfühlt, wann du aufhörst.
